Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Nimbus Supplies - legal docs and PO routing

Marisol — thanks for the quick upload and the ACH doc. A couple of items before I can finalize the vendor master record:

1) Legal name vs invoice header: your W9 lists 'Nimbus Supplies, Inc.' but your invoice header sometimes appears as 'Nimbus Supplies' without the corporate suffix. Can you confirm the exactly preferred legal name for contracts and the exact payee name for invoices?

2) Vendor master form: we require a completed vendor master template (vendor_master_form.xlsx) that captures the ERP coding, tax ID, DUNS (if available), and preferred PO reference. I can send the template if easier — Kimberly, looping you in for ERP/PO fields.

3) Preferred invoicing route: You indicated billing@nimbus-supplies.com. To reduce routing delays please confirm if that is monitored for invoice OCR or if you prefer portal upload. Also, confirm PO matching preference: (a) PO number required on invoice, (b) PO + line-level matching.

4) Tax jurisdiction: please confirm state of incorporation and any withholding notes for our finance team.

If you can return the completed vendor_master_form.xlsx and confirm the payee name, we should be able to populate the master record and route the first PO. If you prefer, we can accept the completed form via DocuSign or as a signed PDF.

Thanks — I’ll hold the PO handoff until we have the completed form and the payee name verified.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
[Attachment: vendor_master_form_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks both — quick finance note:

- We need the tax ID (EIN) exact match to the W9 for the vendor master; if you could place that in the vendor_master_form.xlsx that will unblock automated tax mapping.
- Please confirm net terms (Net30 / Net45) and whether you require remittance advice with ACH notices.
- For PO routing, our ERP uses a primary GL and an expense subcode. If you don’t have a preferred GL we’ll apply the default procurement GL for hardware/services; you can request changes per PO.

I’m attaching the vendor master form (vendor_master_form.xlsx). Fill the highlighted fields (EIN, legal name exactly as on the W9, remit e-mail for invoice OCR, bank details last 4).

I’ll review once returned and request a finance hold release for the initial PO.

Kimberly Park
AP & Vendor Controls | Redwood Inference
